# Run diagnostics for models {.tabset}

## Table of outputs for report

The following are the outputs from sequential updates to the 2023 model (update catch, cpue, length-frequency).

The tables are needed for the report. Modify the input R script to make sure it contains all the model names that you want to include.

```{r tables_of_results_2026}

source("00_extract_derived_quants.R")

knitr::kable(results_updates)
knitr::kable(results_sens)
knitr::kable(results_lik)
knitr::kable(results_sens_lik)

results_updates
results_sens
results_grid
# results1_grid
# results2_grid


```

## Plot model outputs

First, pick a model, then run the scripts below to generate plots for:

* 1: CPUE
* 2: Length frequency
* 3: Selectivity
* 4: Tagging data
* 5: Recruitment
* 6: Movement
* 7: Fishing mortality (F)
* 8: Biomass estimates
* 9: Growth
* 10: Natural mortality (M)
* 11: ss3diags

```{r model_choice}

plot_model <- SS_output(dir= paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS,'4_update_rec/'),covar=TRUE,forecast=FALSE)
base_dir <- paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, '4_update_rec',sep="")

MODEL_NAME <- '4_update_rec'
BASE_2026 <- '4_update_rec'
BASE_2023 <-  '0_base_2023'
mod_base <- '4_update_rec'


## paths

paths_for_models <- c(
  rep(PATH_MODELRUNS, length(mod_update_names)),
  rep(PATH_SENSITIVITES, length(mod_sens_names)))
  #, rep(PATH_GRID, length(mod_grid_names))
# )

models <- c(mod_update_names, mod_sens_names) #, mod_grid_names)

growth_models <- c(paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS,"4_update_rec",sep=""),
                   paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s9_new_growth", sep=""),
                   paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s11_natM_lorenzen_new_grow",sep="")
)

names(growth_models) <- c("base_2026","s9_new_growth", "s11_natM_lorenzen_new_grow") 

plot_grow <- c(paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS,"4_update_rec",sep=""),
                   paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s9_new_growth", sep=""))

names(plot_grow) <- c("base_2026","s9_new_growth")

mod_grow_names <- c("s9_new_growth", "s11_natM_lorenzen_new_grow")

M_models <- c(paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, "4_update_rec", sep=""),
              paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s10_natM_lorenzen", sep=""),
              paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s11_natM_lorenzen_new_grow")
)

names(M_models) <- c("base_2026", "s10_natM_lorenzen", "s11_natM_lorenzen_new_grow")

CPUE_models <- c(paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, "4_update_rec", sep=""),
                 paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s3_cpue_tw", sep=""),
                 paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s4_altCPUE", sep=""),
                 paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s5_altCPUE_esp", sep=""),
                 paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s6_altCPUE_esp_noreu", sep=""),
                 paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s7_altCPUE_prt_reu", sep=""),
                 paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s8_altCPUE_prt", sep="")
                 )

names(CPUE_models) <- c("base_2026", "s3_cpue_tw", "s4_altCPUE" ,"s5_alt_CPUE_esp", "s6_alt_CPUE_esp_noreu", "s7_altCPUE_prt_reu", "s8_altCPUE_prt")

rec_time_models <- c(paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, "4_update_rec", sep=""),
                     paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s1_update_rec_short", sep=""),
                     paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s2_update_mod_time", sep="")
                     )

names(rec_time_models) <- c("base_2026", "s1_update_rec_short", "s2_update_mod_time")

sigma_models <- c(paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, "4_update_rec", sep=""),
                  paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s12_sigma_R4", sep=""),
                  paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s13_sigma_R6", sep="")
                  )
names(sigma_models) <- c("base_2026", "s12_sigma_R4", "s13_sigma_R6")

h_models <- c(paste0(PATH_MODELRUNS, "4_update_rec", sep=""),
              paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s14a_h70", sep=""),
              paste0(PATH_SENSITIVITES, "s14b_h90", sep="")
)
```
